**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute for the given group of words.**

Destruction of a fetus
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "Feticide."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Feticide"** refers to the act of causing the death of a fetus, usually through intentional actions. (आमतौर पर जानबूझकर किए गए कार्यों के माध्यम से भ्रूण की मृत्यु का कारण बनने का कार्य)
 
• It is a term that is often used in legal contexts to describe the unlawful killing of an unborn child.
 
• In legal discussions, feticide may be treated differently from other forms of homicide due to the unique circumstances involved in causing the death of a fetus.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fraticide: **the killing of one's brother or sister. (किसी के भाई या बहन की हत्या)
 
• **Ellipse: **a regular oval like a circle that has been pressed in from two sides. (दो पार्श्वों से दबी हुई अंडाकार आकृति)
 
• **Abhor: **to hate something very much. (अत्‍यधिक घृणा करना)
